verdict.rationale: Poke is an AI assistant, so web-grounded answers with source citations is a fair axis. The evidence pack never documents web search, live web retrieval or citations to sources. The 'Send to Poke' selected-text feature and the generic MCP/integration extensibility are adjacent building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources
